cinder.name: Cinder Fields

texts: A spire of black glass rises from the ash, humming when you stand near it.
A chimney with no house beneath it breathes slow heat into the room.

twists.text: The crust is thin here. Lava has broken through everywhere.
Heat shimmer. Every fight here starts on burning ground.

stories: Scorched into a wall: 'We tried to burn our way out. It made more fire.'
A charred map, every route crossed out but one. The last one is crossed out too, in a different hand.
A note: 'The Maze isn't cruel. It's curious. That's worse.'
cinder.secret: A relic glows in a chamber sealed by lava. Someone who can Float could reach it.
cinder.relicText: Heat rises off the relic as you lift it, then fades, as if it had been waiting for you.

crypt.name: Drowned Crypt

texts: A great bronze bell lies on its side, half full of black water. It rings when nobody touches it.
A bell as tall as a person, green with age. Its clapper is missing.

twists.text: The tide is coming in. The halls are half flooded.
The dead keep watch. There are archers in every fight.
Restless. Twice as many things walk here.

stories: A name carved over and over into a coffin lid, each one shallower than the last.
Graffiti: 'It floods the old rooms so you'll look for new ones.'
A ledger of the dead, kept by someone who added their own name at the bottom.
crypt.secret: A relic rests in a flooded tomb. You'd need to swim to reach it. (A future ability.)
crypt.relicText: The relic is dry, though it sat underwater. It is cold all the way through.

garden.name: Strangler Garden

texts: A tree too big for any room. Its roots go down through the floor into somewhere else.
An enormous elm with doors carved into its trunk. None of them open.

twists.text: The garden grows while you watch. Vines choke the side halls.
Spore beds. Battles here are fought on spiked ground.

stories: A gardener's journal: 'I planted a door. It grew a wall.'
Initials carved into bark, healed over, carved again, healed over again.
A sign, nearly swallowed by moss: 'Do not feed the hedges.'
garden.secret: A relic hangs in a grove walled off by thick vines. You'd need a way to cut through. (A future ability.)
garden.relicText: The relic comes free with a sound like a sigh. The vines around it go slack.
